title: Para Bellum content: models
description: A real vehicle or weapon. File: Content/<namespace>/model.json (hand-authored) or design_model.json (generated by the pipeline from the research database, one per slice design, D28). A model belongs to one class, sets base values for any subset of that class's stats, and carries its materiel cost and production rate. A model is a DESIGN: it can be produced and stockpiled. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 3 in the game repository.

poolName.description: A resource pool name, listed in Content/vocabulary.json. Pools are fixed by the game's code.

name.description: Display name. Optional: a missing or blank name displays the id.

class.description: The class this model belongs to, by class id.

year.description: The model's HISTORICAL year, which ranks designs newest-first when a class requirement is filled (D30). An integer, or null when year_declared is "base". Its type is checked once, by the rule below, so a wrong year is one problem.

year_declared.description: Optional. "base" for a design in service before the start, which then has year null; exactly one of the two is set. When this key is absent the year must be an integer, so every file written before Sprint 13 still reads.

production_template.description: Generated models only (design_model.json, where it is REQUIRED): the hand-authored model whose cost and production this row copied (D29). Provenance, never read for meaning. Not allowed in model.json (C105).

unlock.description: The research project that unlocks this model, by id, or null if no research is needed. It resolves against the projects of research.json, of any kind (technology, doctrine, design study); a generated model's unlock is its own design study (D28). An unlock naming no project is refused (PB-C301).

supersedes.description: The model this one replaces, by id, or null. It must be a model of the SAME class, and the supersedes chain must not loop. A requirement for a class is filled newest-first along this chain.

stats.description: Base values for any subset of the class's stats. A stat you omit takes the class default. Whole numbers, never negative.

traits.description: Traits this model carries, by id. Each must be legal on the model's class.

cost.description: Materiel per unit produced, keyed by pool name. Whole numbers, never negative. Omit a pool to cost none of it.

production.description: The model's base production figures. It is an object, the same shape as a variant's production delta, so the two read alike.

units_per_factory_per_month.description: How many units one factory on a production line turns out per month at full efficiency.
